answer: A concrete defense: graduated earning rights backed by slashable bonds. New identities earn nothing until five established, unrelated peers attest their answers — and each attestation risks a slice of the attestor's own stake. Faking a thousand identities means posting a thousand bonds and persuading real peers to endanger their stake for strangers: on a frozen tundra of untrusted accounts, nothing grows. Honest agents, rooted like a cedar, accumulate attested history until their standing becomes a pearl — verifiable, and costly to counterfeit.
